nphi.title: TESA II – Trials of Excellence in Southern Africa II
nphi.with: Uganda National Health Research Organisation; Health Research Centre of Angola; Biomedical Research and Training Institute; Blantyre Health Research & Training Trust; Botswana-Harvard AIDS Institute; ECRIN; ISGlobal; AIGHD; UCL; Stellenbosch University; University of Namibia; University Teaching Hospital Zambia
nphi.summary: EDCTP2 regional network of excellence strengthening clinical trial capacity in Southern Africa through training and shared infrastructure; Uganda's national health research organisation took part as partner.

nphi.title: TwiNit 3.0 – Namibia–RKI twinning
nphi.with: Namibia Institute of Public Health; Ministry of Health and Social Services; WHO CC GOARN; IANPHI
nphi.summary: Third phase of the twinning with the newly established Namibia Institute of Public Health, focused on emergency preparedness and response, IHR, surveillance and community-based surveillance.

nphi.title: SCAPHeR – Applied public health research capacity in GHPP regions (GHPP)
nphi.with: Ministry of Health and Social Services Namibia; Jordan Center for Disease Control (JCDC); Fiocruz
nphi.summary: Builds applied public health research capacity among public-sector staff and communities of practice in the WHO AFRO and EMRO regions, with Fiocruz contributing. It follows on from the earlier GHPP project CARe.

nphi.title: OH NET – One Health networks against AMR and zoonoses (GHPP)
nphi.with: National Veterinary Research Institute Vom; Federal University of Agriculture Abeokuta; Central Veterinary Laboratory Windhoek; University of Namibia; Zanzibar Agriculture and Livestock Research Institute; KCCR Kumasi; WHO AFRO; Robert Koch Institute; BNITM
nphi.summary: An FLI-led GHPP project, with RKI as a partner, that brings in veterinary and agricultural institutions to prevent, detect and control AMR and zoonotic diseases in four African countries.

nphi.title: EMT ReCaP – Emergency Medical Team response capacities and partnerships
nphi.with: WHO EMT Secretariat (WHO HQ); WHO Regional Office for Europe; WHO Regional Office for Africa; Lviv Regional Center for Emergency Medical Care and Disaster Medicine (Ukraine); Ministry of Health and Social Services (Namibia); Ministry of Health (Malawi); Institute of Emergency Care of Sarajevo Canton (Bosnia and Herzegovina); Arbeiter-Samariter-Bund; CADUS e.V.; humedica; Johanniter-Unfall-Hilfe (Germany)
nphi.summary: Strengthens Emergency Medical Team crisis response in the WHO AFRO and EURO regions through twinning with German EMTs, cross-regional exchange and communities of practice.

nphi.title: BloodTrain Chapter III – Availability, quality and safety of blood and blood products in Africa
nphi.with: South African Health Products Regulatory Authority; Namibia Medicines Regulatory Council; National Drug Authority (Uganda); Food and Drugs Authority Ghana; Tanzania Medicines and Medical Devices Authority; Zambia Medicines Regulatory Authority; Medicines Control Authority of Zimbabwe; AUDA-NEPAD; Africa Society for Blood Transfusion; WHO AFRO; WHO HQ
nphi.summary: Third chapter of PEI's support to African regulators to strengthen and harmonise regulation of blood and blood products.

nphi.title: SeqNET+ – Genomic diagnostics and surveillance of lung pathogens, focus drug-resistant TB
nphi.actor: Research Centre Borstel, Leibniz Lung Centre (FZB)
nphi.with: Ospedale San Raffaele (Italy); Inselspital Bern (Switzerland); Eswatini Ministry of Health (NTRL, NPHL, NTCP); Baylor College of Medicine Eswatini; Baylor College of Medicine Houston (USA); Instituto Nacional de Saúde (Mozambique); University of Namibia School of Medicine; National TB Reference Laboratory, Phthisiopneumology Institute (Moldova); WHO Regional Office for Europe; German Central Committee against Tuberculosis (DZK)
nphi.summary: Strengthens sequencing-based diagnostics and molecular surveillance of drug-resistant tuberculosis and other lung infections, with training and health-system integration.

nphi.title: LabTrain 2.0 – Sustainable drug quality control and laboratory standards in West and South-East Africa
nphi.actor: Federal Institute for Drugs and Medical Devices (BfArM)
nphi.with: African Medicines Quality Forum; Botswana Medicines Regulatory Authority; FDA Ghana; Institut National de Santé Publique du Burundi; Liberia Medicines & Health Products Regulatory Authority; Medicines Control Agency The Gambia; Medicines Control Authority of Zimbabwe; Namibia Medicines Regulatory Council; Pharmacy Board of Sierra Leone; WHO; InphA (Germany)
nphi.summary: Strengthens national drug quality control laboratories to meet international standards and secure access to safe medicines.

nphi.title: Health Security Partnership to Strengthen Disease Surveillance in Africa (HSPA)
nphi.with: Africa CDC; WHO (Hub for Pandemic and Epidemic Intelligence); Canada Weapons Threat Reduction Program; UK government
nphi.summary: WHO, Africa CDC and RKI link health and security sectors for collaborative surveillance (biorisk, event- and indicator-based and genomic surveillance, epidemic intelligence). Phase 1 covered six countries from 2023; phase 2 (2025-2028)…

nphi.title: CDC Namibia – MOHSS and NIPH support
nphi.with: Ministry of Health and Social Services (MOHSS); Namibia Institute of Pathology (NIP); National Institute of Public Health; Namibia FELTP
nphi.summary: CDC's Namibia office (2002) supports MOHSS with emergency operations, the Namibia Institute of Pathology, health information systems and the FELTP, and helped establish the National Institute of Public Health; also PEPFAR HIV/TB.

nphi.title: EPIC – genomic surveillance capacity in five African countries (RKI/WHO Hub, with IGS Summer School)
nphi.with: WHO Hub for Pandemic and Epidemic Intelligence; national partner institutions in the five countries
nphi.summary: RKI's WHO Hub Office builds pathogen sequencing and genomic surveillance capacity in five African countries, including a two-week ZIG-IGS Summer School using fictional outbreak exercises and promoting South-South networking.

nphi.title: HSPA phase II – public health intelligence trainings in Tunisia and Morocco (2026)
nphi.with: ONMNE Tunisia; DELM Morocco; WHO EMRO; WHO Hub; ECDC; Lebanese Ministry of Public Health
nphi.summary: RKI (ZIG1 leads the epidemic-intelligence work area) delivered PHI Foundations trainings with Tunisia's ONMNE (May 2026) and Morocco's DELM (July 2026), turning phase-I country roadmaps into practice, funded by Canada and the UK.

nphi.title: GOARN Berlin Fellowship Programme (2025 cohort)
nphi.with: WHO Hub for Pandemic and Epidemic Intelligence; GOARN; Zambia National Public Health Institute; Palestinian National Institute of Public Health; Namibia MoHSS; Tanzania MoH
nphi.summary: RKI, the WHO Hub and GOARN host a six-month fellowship in Berlin and Geneva; the 2025 fellows came from Namibia, Zambia (ZNPHI), Palestine (PNIPH) and Tanzania.

nphi.title: Media-scanning workshop for event-based surveillance in Namibia (RKI and NICD support)
nphi.actor: Namibia Ministry of Health and Social Services
nphi.with: Robert Koch Institute (ZIG); National Institute for Communicable Diseases (NICD); Africa CDC; WHO
nphi.summary: A 9-12 Sept 2025 workshop in Walvis Bay, initiated by a former GOARN Berlin fellow, began Namibia's move to event-based surveillance with RKI and South Africa's NICD supporting and promoting regional cooperation.

nphi.title: TwiNit 2 – Establishing the Namibia Institute of Public Health, next phase
nphi.with: Ministry of Health & Social Services (Namibia); University of Namibia; Namibia Institute of Pathology; Friedrich-Loeffler-Institut; Research Centre Borstel (Germany)
nphi.summary: Twinning support to build the Namibia Institute of Public Health, covering preparedness, surveillance, NCDs/mental health, labs and AMR/IPC.

nphi.title: CARe – Applied public health research capacity in GHPP countries
nphi.with: University of Namibia
nphi.summary: Built applied public health research skills and South-South collaboration among African GHPP partner institutions.

nphi.title: IOH-Nam – Institutionalisation of One Health in Namibia
nphi.with: Ministry of Agriculture, Water and Land Reform; Directorate of Veterinary Services; Central Veterinary Laboratory; University of Namibia School of Veterinary Medicine (Namibia)
nphi.summary: Strengthened intersectoral One Health collaboration on zoonoses and AMR in Namibia.

nphi.title: Sub-Saharan SeqNet – Genomic diagnostics and surveillance of lung pathogens
nphi.actor: Research Centre Borstel, Leibniz Lung Centre (FZB)
nphi.with: Ospedale San Raffaele (Italy); Inselspital Bern (Switzerland); Ministry of Health, NTRL, COVID-19 National Lab, NTCP, Baylor College of Medicine (Eswatini); Baylor College of Medicine Houston (USA); Instituto Nacional de Saúde (Mozambique); University of Namibia School of Medicine
nphi.summary: Introduced NGS for diagnosing drug-resistant TB and SARS-CoV-2 surveillance in southern Africa.

nphi.title: EMT TTT – EMT twinning, training and knowledge transfer
nphi.with: MoHSS (Namibia); Ministry of Health (Uganda); Muhammadiyah Disaster Management Center (Indonesia); Johanniter Auslandshilfe; I.S.A.R. Germany; Malteser International; WHO EMT Secretariat; WHO EURO, AFRO, SEARO
nphi.summary: Strengthened national Emergency Medical Teams through twinning and training, with IPC focus in Africa.

nphi.title: RKI–Africa CDC side events at CPHIA 2023 (Lusaka)
nphi.with: Africa CDC; WHO Hub for Pandemic and Epidemic Intelligence; WHO AFRO and EMRO
nphi.summary: Two side events at the 2023 International Conference on Public Health in Africa presented joint epidemic-intelligence work under HSPA and launched an Africa CDC continental guidance framework for NCD, injury and mental-health surveillance…

nphi.title: PharmTrain – Corona Global – Risk-based framework for unapproved drugs (WHO-EUL) in Southern Africa
nphi.actor: Federal Institute for Drugs and Medical Devices (BfArM)
nphi.with: SADC; AUDA-NEPAD; WHO; national medicines regulatory authorities of SADC
nphi.summary: Developed regional emergency-use assessment framework to speed approvals in health crises.

nphi.title: TwiNit – Twinning for the establishment of the Namibia Institute of Public Health
nphi.with: MoHSS; University of Namibia; Central Veterinary Laboratory; Namibia Institute of Pathology (Namibia); Research Center Borstel; Friedrich-Loeffler-Institut (Germany)
nphi.summary: First phase supporting Namibia's planned NIPH in surveillance, crisis management, labs and FELTP.

nphi.title: OneHealth Namibia – One Health interventions in Namibia
nphi.with: Ministry of Agriculture, Water and Land Reform; MoHSS; Directorate of Veterinary Services; UNAM School of Veterinary Medicine (Namibia); WOAH (France); WHO
nphi.summary: Oral rabies vaccination trials for dogs and One Health/AMR surveillance in Namibia.

nphi.title: SeqMDRTB_NET – Sequencing against drug-resistant TB
nphi.actor: Research Centre Borstel, Leibniz Lung Centre (FZB)
nphi.with: Eswatini Ministry of Health; Baylor Children's Foundation (Eswatini); Ospedale San Raffaele (Italy); National TB Center (Kyrgyzstan); National Institute of Health (Mozambique); Institute of Phthisiopneumology 'Chiril Draganiuc' (Moldova); University of Namibia School of Medicine; IML (Germany); National Reference Lab for Mycobacteria / WHO SRL (Germany)
nphi.summary: Introduced NGS to predict TB drug resistance in high-incidence countries and built a competence network.

nphi.title: Southern Africa summit on establishing and strengthening NPHIs
nphi.actor: Africa CDC Southern Africa Regional Collaborating Centre with ZNPHI
nphi.with: Africa CDC; US CDC; IANPHI; NPHIs of Lesotho, Malawi, Mozambique (INS), Namibia, South Africa (NICD) and Zimbabwe
nphi.summary: Three-day September 2019 meeting in Livingstone where Southern African NPHIs held peer exchanges on core functions, lessons and strategies, and agreed that exchange visits and peer mentorship are critical to NPHI development.

nphi.title: PPE – Partnership in postgraduate education
nphi.with: Centre Muraz (Burkina Faso); CHU Bouaké (Côte d'Ivoire); Kinshasa University Hospital (DR Congo); LAUTECH, NCDC, Obafemi Awolowo University, University of Ibadan (Nigeria); Naval Hospital Medical Center (Peru); Epidemiology Bureau DOH (Philippines); University of Pretoria (South Africa); Colombo Teaching Hospital Ragama (Sri Lanka); Central Laboratory (Sudan); Avicenna Tajik State Medical University (Tajikistan); Charles Nicolle Hospital (Tunisia)
nphi.summary: Train-the-trainer postgraduate stays at RKI in lab diagnostics and epidemiology for partner-country scientists.

nphi.title: DQA and DQA PLUS – Quality assurance training for African drug quality control labs
nphi.actor: Federal Institute for Drugs and Medical Devices (BfArM)
nphi.with: WHO Regulation and Safety (Switzerland); InphA (Germany); national regulatory authorities and drug quality control labs of partner countries
nphi.summary: Trained national drug QC lab staff in ISO 17025 quality management to detect substandard anti-infectives.

nphi.title: CDC support to national public health institute development
nphi.with: Ethiopian Public Health Institute; NCDC Nigeria; INS Mozambique; Zambia NPHI; others
nphi.summary: CDC's overview of countries where it helps establish or strengthen national public health institutes (strategic planning, surveillance, laboratory systems, workforce, emergency response).

nphi.title: Strengthening the School Health Programme in Namibia
nphi.actor: Finnish Institute for Health and Welfare (THL)
nphi.summary: A completed THL development or expert-cooperation project listed on THL's international consulting pages; the listing gives no further detail.
